title: How does a specialist obtain internet research capability?
statement: REQ-0003 requires that implementation questions be answerable from current external sources. Nothing in the shipped package provides that. What gives the research specialist the ability — a Pi extension wrapping a search API, an MCP server, something else — and who holds the credential?
notes: BLOCKING under DEC-0002 — see the earlier note. BOUNDARIES BEFORE MECHANISM (DEC-0003): (a) what counts as research — which questions a specialist may take externally, and which it must refuse; (b) where external access comes from — the host capability, and who holds the credential; (c) how provenance is retained — every claim taken externally must land as evidence(kind: source) with its citations, since REQ-0004 is otherwise unenforceable at the point it matters; (d) how the system behaves when the capability is UNAVAILABLE — an explicit refusal or recorded gap, never a specialist answering from what it already holds, which is the intake's original complaint restored. Only after those four does the mechanism question — extension, MCP, something else — become answerable.
